decision.rationale: The successful r1b exact-input, evidence-manifest and seal chains verify; the receipt, reports and mapped netlist independently agree on 7588.223873 um2, 7746 cells, 1170 sequential cells, 68 logic levels, +0.6302 ns setup, +0.0251 ns hold, five clean constraint classes and zero macros. No P0/P1 is present in the postcompile warning set or timing boundary, so RTL-to-netlist Formality and explicitly prelayout PT-STA are admitted. Power is not admitted because the exact VCS evidence has no SAIF/VCD/FSDB activity file.

verified_gates.failed_r1_reason: RUN_FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE is present and runner_sha256.txt is empty; its internally hashing RUN_COMPLETE payload cannot override that fatal provenance.

logic_only_cost.interpretation: The nominal 3 ns pass is expensive and hold-fix dominated. These rounded-log deltas are diagnostic synthesis inflation, not physical ECO area.

warning_disposition.VER_104: P2: the unsupported unlabeled fatal is only the frozen FIFO_DEPTH!=8 generate guard; admitted FIFO_DEPTH is eight. Keep the parameter preflight exact and clean the synthesis-only assertion later.
warning_disposition.VER_318: P2: lines 223/279/283 convert positive bounded constants or center_index values in 0..31. Exact-SHA VCS reports zero numeric/order mismatch; use explicit unsigned casts before signoff-quality lint.
warning_disposition.TIM_216: P2: only asynchronous reset_n lacks a clock-relative input delay and the mapped SDC explicitly false-paths it. Recovery/removal is therefore outside this prelayout point.
warning_disposition.TIM_134: P2: only ideal clk_core is high fanout at 1170 loads and DC substitutes fanout 1000. This cannot support physical timing or clock-tree claims.
warning_disposition.LINT_29_31_52: P2: all 29 feedthroughs, 330 shorted-output notices and 62 constant-output notices resolve to the declared top-level shared-output boundary; none is an internal multi-driver, latch or unresolved reference.
warning_disposition.UCN_1: P2: all 123 notices are nets whose base names are declared top-level outputs; mapped Verilog assign statements are expected at this interface boundary.

findings.title: Hold repair dominates controller cost
findings.detail: The final cut contains 1233 explicit delay cells occupying 2057.705994 um2, 27.117% of total cell area. Relative to the rounded pre-hold optimizer point, final area grows about 46.09% and cells about 37.29%.

findings.title: Timing remains ideal-clock and ZeroWireload
findings.detail: The +0.6302/+0.0251 ns setup/hold results have no clock tree, parasitics or SRAM macros; clk_core high-fanout substitution and reset recovery/removal remain outside the claim.

findings.title: Activity-backed power is absent
findings.detail: No SAIF, VCD or FSDB exists in the exact-SHA M384 VCS evidence. PTPX without a frozen activity mapping is NO-GO.

findings.title: Storage and compute boundary is incomplete
findings.detail: The cut realizes 512 phase-center bits and an optimized 312 of 384 FIFO bits as flops, while descriptor/PWP SRAM, q32 matching and PWP compute remain external.

findings.title: Synthesis/lint warnings require signoff cleanup
findings.detail: VER-104, three VER-318 conversions, TIM-216, TIM-134, LINT-29/31/52 and UCN-1 are bounded and do not block exploratory Formality/PT, but must not be silently omitted from a later signoff receipt.

findings.title: The first M387 directory is non-citable failed provenance
findings.detail: It includes an explicit failure marker and empty runner hash even though its payload manifest still hashes. Only r1b is primary evidence.

next_synopsys_admission.formality: GO: use the exact RTL, r1b SVF and mapped netlist; require verified equivalence and double-sealed logs.
next_synopsys_admission.prelayout_ptsta: GO: use exact mapped Verilog/SDC and min/max libraries; retain ideal-clock/ZeroWireload/prelayout wording and report reset/clock limitations.
next_synopsys_admission.ptpx: NO-GO until an exact-SHA VCS workload emits SAIF and name/activity coverage is reconciled against the mapped netlist.
